notes.title: Morphies Law is Growing!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/9564587fadc7a35d08cf6caa96aa1e37909366cd.png[/img]

[b]10 days[/b] ago the Morphies arrived. Since then [b]9’200 Morphies[/b] across Steam and Switch have joined the hunt for mass. Morphies were [b]disassembled 337’243 times[/b] in their fight to grow their avatar, resulting in [b]49’333 won matches[/b]. Up to [b]2’200 Morphies[/b] were playing on the dedicated servers daily and have stolen [b]7’882’652 tons[/b] of mass per day – and the momentum is growing, with hundreds of new Morphies joining every day. Overall steam reviews are at [b]94% positive[/b] (88% of the ones by Steam customers) and the press reviews ranged from good to great (check [url=https://twitter.com/MorphiesLaw]our Twitter account[/url] for some of them). 
This is a huge encouragement for us, and we will keep the morph madness going. You will hear from us soon!

[b]The Morphies Law crew[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/948960/Morphies_Law_Remorphed/

notes.title: Body-ballooning shooter Morphie's Law is now out on PC
notes.content:
Mind when games had big head mode? Morphie’s Law: Remorphed is a bit like that, but with your character’s whole body. The RPS treehouse have had our eyes on this body-morphing multiplayer game for a while: it’s a third-person shooter where blasting someone’s body-part causes it to shrink and yours to grow. For example – shot someone in the foot? Congratulations, you’ll be needing bigger boots and they’ll be downsizing to baby shoes.

It’s a bit less body horror than that sounds, wrapped up in a robot Day Of The Dead look that probably isn’t quite in the spirit of the holiday. Oh, and it’s out now, with a demo you can pop on for free.

notes.title: Morphies Law Remorphed Release Date
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/07afa03f78c4cb5391ccedc382c3496b79100076.png[/img]

[h1]Morphies Law [strike]2.0[/strike] Remorphed is almost here![/h1]

We’re super excited to finally share the release date of [b]Morphies Law: Remorphed[/b] with everyone. On July 30th Remorphed will launch right here on Steam and will be available to all existing [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/morphies-law-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] owners as a free update. 

Remorphed is everything you loved about Morphies Law, with none of the leftovers. It’s always been about the Mass, so let’s take a look at what you can expect later this month: 

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*] The Morphies have 8 body parts that grow and shrink individually, and each body part has a direct effect on your actions. 
[*] Each body part has a unique Plugin to help you change your strategy. Unlock new Plugins to create brand new strategies.
[*] You can unlock weapon parts and combine them at will to make the perfect weapon for you! 
[*] Four mass-based game modes with different goals but with one thing in common: size always matters more than kills!
[*] Eight maps where each one has a unique mass-related feature that'll make it different from the rest! 
[*] Make your Morphie truly unique! You can choose from premade options, make your own custom ones and much more![/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YQ5iZRB0sPw&feature=youtu.be

We’re also really pleased to confirm that not only will Remorphed launch with [b]Dedicated Servers[/b], it will also support crossplay between [b]Steam and Nintendo Switch[/b]. ːsteamhappyː

[quote=Some guy at Morphie HQ]We’re extremely happy to be bringing our game to Steam and a newly updated version to the Switch. We believe that gamers will love the twist that we’ve added on to shooter combat and the extensive customization options we’ve put in the game.[/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/803f9f40492642c79790a7d065687f18f47e452d.png[/img]

[b]Beta Events & The Morphies Community[/b]

We’ve been running a number of beta testing events with our Community over on Discord. We want to take a moment to thank them all for their continued support and incredible feedback week after week. We’ve used this to fine-tune the game during the critical pre-release phase and without their support, our job would have been a lot harder. Thank you to everyone who took part in one or all the beta events, even if you’re not in Discord. 

If you haven’t already, join over 5000 other Morphies in the Official Morphies Law Discord below!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/13aaf6e82bd4dc6a7caf59ff9c4c4c39d4b2daf6.png[/img]

Don’t forget to Wishlist Morphies Law Remorphed if you haven’t already, and help us spread the word. Enjoy the screenshots below and we’ll see you on [b]July 30th![/b]

notes.title: Morphies Law: Remorphed expands onto PC this month
notes.content:
Morphies Law: Remorphed has appeared like a background extra on RPS over the past two years, with only fleeting glimpses of this strange multiplayer shooter where you exchange mass with other players. But here it is. The star of the show. The main playa. It s arriving on PC on July 30th, so let s see what this team-based shooter has to offer.

notes.title: Let’s break Morphies Law 2.0!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/a2ea3e1a7679776b1e799d4a633bd921e1227f10.gif[/img]

[b]It’s time Morphies… time to see if you can break Morphies Law!  [/b]

We’re super excited to show you what we’ve been working on for Morphies Law 2.0 and this weekend we’re opening up the first of our PC beta testing sessions. Help us attempt to break the game and in the process earn exclusive in-game cosmetics (which can be transferred over to your Switch account!) whilst testing Head Hunt 2.0, Morphies Saloon and Tanker Town 2.0 and so much more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/dca1343f747f24fe4dd0bbe55a21204434b54b8e.gif[/img]

The first closed beta session will begin on [u]May 18th at 7PM CEST/1PM EST[/u]. See the date in [url=https://notime.zone/Levx2u8YGbvq4]your time zone here[/url].

To get involved all you need to do is [url=https://discord.gg/MorphiesLaw]join our Discord server[/url] and claim your Steam beta key from our Broken Morphie Bot! ːsteamhappyː

You can check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WDnqxN5EIxk]latest beta trailer here[/url]. See you in game very soon!
